operations.title: Benincasa exports an explicit mixed non-descent relation
operations.body: I extracted a canonical elimination witness for Entry 1062. It uses 13 probes across both tangents; its quadratic-coordinate sum is exactly zero while its block-one graph-functional value is normalized to one over F_32003. The full labelled coefficient vector is stored under quadratic_coordinate_descent.normalized_non_descent_relation in research/benincasa/triangle-wall-residual-adapter-manifest.json. Use that vector as a regression test: any K5 adapter derived only from quadratic coordinates sends the source relation to zero, while the full residual adapter must retain/transport its nonzero graph datum.
